presentations.name: A criação
presentations.summary:
Deus cria e ordena o mundo, e a humanidade recebe uma vocação dentro dele.

O início de Gênesis apresenta criação, dignidade humana e responsabilidade como fundamentos da narrativa.

presentations.name: Creation
presentations.summary:
God creates and orders the world, giving humanity a vocation within it.

Genesis introduces creation, human dignity and responsibility as foundations of the narrative.

presentations.name: O jardim e a vocação humana
presentations.summary:
O ser humano é colocado no jardim para cultivá-lo e guardá-lo.

Trabalho, limites e companhia aparecem antes da ruptura narrada no capítulo seguinte.

presentations.name: The garden and humanity’s calling
presentations.summary:
The human being is placed in the garden to cultivate and care for it.

Work, boundaries and companionship appear before the rupture narrated in the next chapter.

presentations.name: A desobediência e a saída do jardim
presentations.summary:
A desobediência rompe a confiança e leva à saída do jardim.

A narrativa conecta vergonha, conflito e mortalidade à necessidade de restauração.

presentations.name: Disobedience and departure from Eden
presentations.summary:
Disobedience breaks trust and leads to departure from the garden.

The narrative connects shame, conflict and mortality with the need for restoration.

presentations.name: Caim e Abel
presentations.summary:
Caim mata seu irmão, e Deus o confronta sobre o sangue derramado.

O conflito humano se amplia da desobediência à violência entre irmãos.

presentations.name: Cain and Abel
presentations.summary:
Cain kills his brother, and God confronts him about the blood shed.

Human conflict expands from disobedience to violence between brothers.

presentations.name: Noé e a arca
presentations.summary:
Em um mundo marcado pela violência, Noé recebe instruções para construir a arca.

O relato coloca juízo e preservação da vida lado a lado.

presentations.name: Noah and the ark
presentations.summary:
In a world marked by violence, Noah receives instructions to build the ark.

The account places judgment alongside the preservation of life.

presentations.name: O dilúvio
presentations.summary:
Noé, sua família e os animais entram na arca antes da chegada das águas.

Este episódio continua a história da arca e prepara o recomeço após o dilúvio.

presentations.name: The flood
presentations.summary:
Noah, his family and the animals enter the ark before the waters arrive.

This episode continues the ark narrative and prepares for a new beginning after the flood.

presentations.name: A aliança com Noé
presentations.summary:
Deus estabelece uma aliança com Noé, seus descendentes e os seres vivos.

O arco nas nuvens acompanha uma promessa de preservação e novas orientações para a vida.

presentations.name: The covenant with Noah
presentations.summary:
God establishes a covenant with Noah, his descendants and living creatures.

The rainbow accompanies a promise of preservation and renewed instructions for life.

presentations.name: A torre de Babel
presentations.summary:
A construção de uma cidade e de uma torre termina com a dispersão dos povos.

Da dispersão das nações, Gênesis passa à história de uma família ligada à promessa de bênção.

presentations.name: The tower of Babel
presentations.summary:
The building of a city and tower ends with the scattering of peoples.

From the scattering of nations, Genesis turns to a family connected with the promise of blessing.

presentations.name: O chamado de Abraão
presentations.summary:
Abrão deixa sua terra em resposta a um chamado acompanhado de promessas.

A promessa de terra, descendência e bênção orienta a história dos patriarcas.

presentations.name: The calling of Abraham
presentations.summary:
Abram leaves his homeland in response to a call accompanied by promises.

The promise of land, descendants and blessing guides the patriarchal narrative.

presentations.name: A aliança com Abraão
presentations.summary:
Abrão apresenta suas dúvidas sobre a descendência e recebe uma promessa confirmada por aliança.

O episódio aprofunda a relação entre confiança, promessa e espera.

presentations.name: The covenant with Abraham
presentations.summary:
Abram voices doubts about descendants and receives a promise confirmed by covenant.

The episode deepens the relationship between trust, promise and waiting.

presentations.name: O nascimento de Isaque
presentations.summary:
Sara dá à luz Isaque, o filho prometido a Abraão.

O nascimento marca uma etapa da promessa, mas os conflitos familiares continuam.

presentations.name: The birth of Isaac
presentations.summary:
Sarah gives birth to Isaac, the son promised to Abraham.

The birth marks a stage in the promise, while family conflicts continue.

presentations.name: Abraão é provado
presentations.summary:
Abraão leva Isaque ao monte; um mensageiro interrompe o sacrifício e um carneiro é oferecido.

O relato trata de prova, confiança e provisão e deve ser lido até seu desfecho.

presentations.name: Abraham is tested
presentations.summary:
Abraham takes Isaac to the mountain; a messenger stops the sacrifice and a ram is offered.

The account concerns testing, trust and provision and should be read through to its conclusion.

presentations.name: O sonho de Jacó em Betel
presentations.summary:
Durante sua viagem, Jacó sonha e recebe a promessa da presença de Deus.

As promessas feitas a Abraão reaparecem na história da geração seguinte.

presentations.name: Jacob’s dream at Bethel
presentations.summary:
During his journey, Jacob dreams and receives the promise of God’s presence.

The promises made to Abraham reappear in the next generation’s story.

presentations.name: Jacó recebe o nome Israel
presentations.summary:
Às vésperas de encontrar Esaú, Jacó luta durante a noite e recebe um novo nome.

O nome Israel liga a experiência de Jacó à identidade do povo que descenderá dele.

presentations.name: Jacob receives the name Israel
presentations.summary:
Before meeting Esau, Jacob wrestles through the night and receives a new name.

The name Israel links Jacob’s experience to the identity of the people descended from him.

presentations.name: José é vendido
presentations.summary:
Os irmãos de José o vendem, e ele é levado ao Egito.

O conflito familiar desloca a narrativa para o cenário em que Israel mais tarde viverá.

presentations.name: Joseph is sold
presentations.summary:
Joseph’s brothers sell him, and he is taken to Egypt.

Family conflict moves the narrative to the setting where Israel will later live.

presentations.name: José se revela aos irmãos
presentations.summary:
José revela sua identidade e convida a família a viver no Egito durante a fome.

A reunião da família explica a transição entre a história dos patriarcas e a abertura de Êxodo.

presentations.name: Joseph reveals himself to his brothers
presentations.summary:
Joseph reveals his identity and invites the family to live in Egypt during the famine.

The family reunion explains the transition from the patriarchs to the opening of Exodus.

presentations.name: O nascimento de Moisés
presentations.summary:
Moisés é preservado ainda bebê e cresce na casa da filha de Faraó.

Sua história começa entre a opressão de seu povo e o ambiente da corte egípcia.

presentations.name: The birth of Moses
presentations.summary:
Moses is preserved as a baby and grows up in Pharaoh’s daughter’s household.

His story begins between the oppression of his people and the Egyptian court.

presentations.name: O chamado na sarça
presentations.summary:
Deus chama Moisés para conduzir os israelitas para fora do Egito.

O chamado responde ao sofrimento apresentado no início de Êxodo.

presentations.name: The call at the burning bush
presentations.summary:
God calls Moses to lead the Israelites out of Egypt.

The call responds to the suffering described at the beginning of Exodus.

presentations.name: A primeira Páscoa
presentations.summary:
As famílias recebem orientações para a Páscoa na noite da saída do Egito.

A libertação passa a ser lembrada por uma celebração transmitida às gerações.

presentations.name: The first Passover
presentations.summary:
Households receive instructions for Passover on the night of departure from Egypt.

Deliverance becomes the focus of a celebration handed down through generations.

presentations.name: A saída do Egito e a travessia do mar
presentations.summary:
Os israelitas atravessam o mar enquanto o exército egípcio os persegue.

A travessia ocupa um lugar central na memória bíblica da libertação.

presentations.name: Leaving Egypt and crossing the sea
presentations.summary:
The Israelites cross the sea while the Egyptian army pursues them.

The crossing holds a central place in the biblical memory of deliverance.

presentations.name: O maná no deserto
presentations.summary:
O povo recebe alimento no deserto e orientações sobre sua coleta.

Depois da saída do Egito, a narrativa trata da dependência e da vida cotidiana em liberdade.

presentations.name: Manna in the wilderness
presentations.summary:
The people receive food in the wilderness and instructions for gathering it.

After leaving Egypt, the narrative turns to dependence and daily life in freedom.

presentations.name: A aliança no Sinai
presentations.summary:
Israel chega ao Sinai e recebe os mandamentos que orientam sua vida como povo.

A libertação é seguida por uma aliança que envolve culto, convivência e responsabilidade.

presentations.name: The covenant at Sinai
presentations.summary:
Israel reaches Sinai and receives commandments guiding its life as a people.

Deliverance is followed by a covenant involving worship, community and responsibility.

presentations.name: O bezerro de ouro
presentations.summary:
Durante a ausência de Moisés, o povo faz um bezerro de ouro; Moisés intercede.

A crise evidencia a fragilidade da fidelidade à aliança recém-estabelecida.

presentations.name: The golden calf
presentations.summary:
During Moses’ absence, the people make a golden calf; Moses intercedes.

The crisis exposes the fragility of faithfulness to the newly established covenant.

presentations.name: Os espias e a crise de confiança
presentations.summary:
O relato dos espias divide o povo e leva à recusa de avançar para a terra.

O episódio explica o prolongamento da jornada pelo deserto na narrativa.

presentations.name: The spies and the crisis of trust
presentations.summary:
The spies’ report divides the people and leads to their refusal to enter the land.

The episode explains the prolonged wilderness journey within the narrative.

presentations.name: A morte de Moisés
presentations.summary:
Moisés vê a terra antes de morrer, e Josué assume a liderança.

O encerramento do Pentateuco prepara a mudança de geração e de liderança.

presentations.name: The death of Moses
presentations.summary:
Moses sees the land before dying, and Joshua takes up leadership.

The conclusion of the Pentateuch prepares a change of generation and leadership.

presentations.name: A travessia do Jordão
presentations.summary:
Sob a liderança de Josué, o povo atravessa o Jordão.

A travessia marca a passagem da jornada pelo deserto à entrada na terra.

presentations.name: Crossing the Jordan
presentations.summary:
Under Joshua’s leadership, the people cross the Jordan.

The crossing marks the transition from the wilderness journey to entering the land.

presentations.name: Jericó
presentations.summary:
O livro de Josué narra a tomada de Jericó e a preservação de Raabe e sua família.

É um episódio da narrativa de conquista, com questões de juízo, guerra e acolhimento.

presentations.name: Jericho
presentations.summary:
Joshua recounts the taking of Jericho and the preservation of Rahab and her family.

It is an episode in the conquest narrative involving judgment, war and refuge.

presentations.name: A renovação da aliança
presentations.summary:
Josué reúne o povo em Siquém para recordar sua história e renovar o compromisso com Deus.

A memória da jornada fundamenta a decisão sobre como viver na terra.

presentations.name: Renewing the covenant
presentations.summary:
Joshua gathers the people at Shechem to recall their history and renew their commitment to God.

Memory of the journey grounds the decision about how to live in the land.

presentations.name: Débora e Baraque
presentations.summary:
Débora orienta Baraque na luta contra as forças de Sísera.

O relato reúne liderança profética e a participação decisiva de diferentes personagens.

presentations.name: Deborah and Barak
presentations.summary:
Deborah guides Barak in the struggle against Sisera’s forces.

The account brings together prophetic leadership and the decisive participation of several people.

presentations.name: Gideão e o pequeno exército
presentations.summary:
O exército de Gideão é reduzido antes do confronto com os midianitas.

A redução das forças desloca o foco do poder militar para a dependência de Deus.

presentations.name: Gideon and the small army
presentations.summary:
Gideon’s army is reduced before confronting the Midianites.

The reduction shifts attention from military strength to dependence on God.

presentations.name: Rute e Noemi
presentations.summary:
Rute acompanha Noemi a Belém, e a história termina com uma família ligada à linhagem de Davi.

Situada no tempo dos juízes, a narrativa destaca lealdade e cuidado em meio à vulnerabilidade.

presentations.name: Ruth and Naomi
presentations.summary:
Ruth accompanies Naomi to Bethlehem, and the story ends with a family linked to David’s line.

Set in the time of the judges, the narrative highlights loyalty and care amid vulnerability.

presentations.name: O chamado de Samuel
presentations.summary:
Samuel ouve o chamado de Deus enquanto serve com Eli.

Sua atuação fará a ponte entre o período dos juízes e a formação da monarquia.

presentations.name: The calling of Samuel
presentations.summary:
Samuel hears God’s call while serving with Eli.

His work will bridge the period of the judges and the formation of the monarchy.

presentations.name: Israel pede um rei
presentations.summary:
O povo pede um rei, e Samuel apresenta os custos dessa forma de governo.

O episódio introduz as tensões que acompanharão a monarquia.

presentations.name: Israel asks for a king
presentations.summary:
The people ask for a king, and Samuel describes the costs of this form of rule.

The episode introduces tensions that will accompany the monarchy.

presentations.name: Saul é ungido
presentations.summary:
Samuel unge Saul, que depois é apresentado ao povo como rei.

A liderança passa a incluir uma instituição real, sem encerrar o papel dos profetas.

presentations.name: Saul is anointed
presentations.summary:
Samuel anoints Saul, who is later presented to the people as king.

Leadership now includes a royal institution without ending the prophets’ role.

presentations.name: A unção de Davi
presentations.summary:
Samuel vai à casa de Jessé e unge Davi.

A escolha ocorre antes de Davi assumir o trono, abrindo uma longa transição.

presentations.name: The anointing of David
presentations.summary:
Samuel goes to Jesse’s house and anoints David.

The choice occurs before David takes the throne, beginning a long transition.

presentations.name: Davi e Golias
presentations.summary:
Davi enfrenta Golias quando os exércitos de Israel e dos filisteus estão reunidos.

O episódio apresenta publicamente Davi e contrasta aparência, força e confiança.

presentations.name: David and Goliath
presentations.summary:
David faces Goliath while the armies of Israel and the Philistines are gathered.

The episode brings David into public view and contrasts appearance, strength and trust.

presentations.name: Davi reina e toma Jerusalém
presentations.summary:
Davi é reconhecido como rei de todo Israel e toma Jerusalém.

A cidade passa a ocupar um lugar central na história da monarquia.

presentations.name: David reigns and takes Jerusalem
presentations.summary:
David is recognized as king over all Israel and takes Jerusalem.

The city takes a central place in the monarchy’s story.

presentations.name: A promessa à casa de Davi
presentations.summary:
Natã transmite a Davi uma promessa relacionada à sua descendência e ao reino.

A promessa se torna uma referência importante para a esperança real nas Escrituras.

presentations.name: The promise to David’s house
presentations.summary:
Nathan delivers a promise to David concerning his descendants and kingdom.

The promise becomes an important reference for royal hope in Scripture.

presentations.name: Natã confronta Davi
presentations.summary:
Após os atos de Davi contra Bate-Seba e Urias, Natã confronta o rei.

A narrativa mostra que o poder real também é submetido ao juízo moral.

presentations.name: Nathan confronts David
presentations.summary:
After David’s actions against Bathsheba and Uriah, Nathan confronts the king.

The narrative shows that royal power is also subject to moral judgment.

presentations.name: Salomão pede sabedoria
presentations.summary:
No início de seu reinado, Salomão pede discernimento para governar.

A sabedoria é apresentada em relação à responsabilidade de fazer justiça.

presentations.name: Solomon asks for wisdom
presentations.summary:
Early in his reign, Solomon asks for discernment to govern.

Wisdom is presented in relation to the responsibility to administer justice.

presentations.name: A dedicação do templo
presentations.summary:
Salomão reúne o povo para a dedicação do templo e faz uma oração.

O templo se torna uma referência para culto, oração, arrependimento e memória da aliança.

presentations.name: The dedication of the temple
presentations.summary:
Solomon gathers the people for the temple’s dedication and offers a prayer.

The temple becomes a reference point for worship, prayer, repentance and covenant memory.

presentations.name: A divisão do reino
presentations.summary:
Após Salomão, o conflito com Roboão resulta na separação entre os reinos.

A partir daqui, Reis acompanha trajetórias paralelas de Israel e Judá.

presentations.name: The division of the kingdom
presentations.summary:
After Solomon, conflict with Rehoboam results in the separation of the kingdoms.

From here, Kings follows the parallel histories of Israel and Judah.

presentations.name: Elias no monte Carmelo
presentations.summary:
Elias confronta os profetas de Baal diante do povo.

O confronto coloca a fidelidade religiosa no centro da crise do reino do norte.

presentations.name: Elijah on Mount Carmel
presentations.summary:
Elijah confronts the prophets of Baal before the people.

The confrontation places religious allegiance at the center of the northern kingdom’s crisis.

presentations.name: Elias no Horebe
presentations.summary:
Elias foge, recebe cuidado e encontra uma nova direção para sua missão.

A narrativa passa do confronto público à fragilidade e à continuidade da vocação profética.

presentations.name: Elijah at Horeb
presentations.summary:
Elijah flees, receives care and finds renewed direction for his mission.

The narrative moves from public confrontation to vulnerability and the continuation of prophetic calling.

presentations.name: Eliseu e Naamã
presentations.summary:
Naamã procura cura e recebe de Eliseu uma orientação que inicialmente rejeita.

O encontro atravessa fronteiras políticas e desafia expectativas de prestígio e poder.

presentations.name: Elisha and Naaman
presentations.summary:
Naaman seeks healing and receives instructions from Elisha that he initially rejects.

The encounter crosses political boundaries and challenges expectations of prestige and power.

presentations.name: O chamado de Isaías
presentations.summary:
Isaías relata uma visão, sua purificação e o envio para anunciar uma mensagem.

O chamado apresenta a tensão entre santidade, resistência do povo e missão profética.

presentations.name: The calling of Isaiah
presentations.summary:
Isaiah recounts a vision, his cleansing and his commission to proclaim a message.

The call introduces the tension between holiness, the people’s resistance and prophetic mission.

presentations.name: A queda de Samaria
presentations.summary:
O reino do norte cai sob o domínio assírio, e parte da população é deportada.

Reis interpreta a queda à luz da história religiosa e política de Israel.

presentations.name: The fall of Samaria
presentations.summary:
The northern kingdom falls under Assyrian rule, and part of its population is deported.

Kings interprets the fall in light of Israel’s religious and political history.

presentations.name: Josias e o livro da Lei
presentations.summary:
Um livro é encontrado no templo, e Josias promove uma renovação da aliança.

A leitura pública e as reformas mostram o papel da memória escrita na vida do povo.

presentations.name: Josiah and the book of the Law
presentations.summary:
A book is found in the temple, and Josiah leads a renewal of the covenant.

Public reading and reform show the role of written memory in the people’s life.

presentations.name: Jeremias e o sermão do templo
presentations.summary:
Jeremias denuncia a confiança no templo quando a conduta cotidiana contradiz a aliança.

A advertência prepara a leitura da crise de Jerusalém para além da segurança de suas instituições.

presentations.name: Jeremiah and the temple sermon
presentations.summary:
Jeremiah challenges confidence in the temple when daily conduct contradicts the covenant.

The warning prepares readers to understand Jerusalem’s crisis beyond trust in its institutions.

presentations.name: A queda de Jerusalém e o exílio
presentations.summary:
Jerusalém é tomada, o templo é destruído e ocorre uma nova deportação.

A perda de cidade, templo e governo redefine o cenário da narrativa bíblica.

presentations.name: The fall of Jerusalem and exile
presentations.summary:
Jerusalem is taken, the temple is destroyed and another deportation follows.

The loss of city, temple and government reshapes the setting of the biblical narrative.

presentations.name: A carta aos exilados
presentations.summary:
Jeremias orienta os exilados a construir uma vida no lugar para onde foram levados.

A carta ajuda a compreender a espera no exílio; sua posição aqui é temática, não uma data posterior à queda.

presentations.name: The letter to the exiles
presentations.summary:
Jeremiah instructs the exiles to build a life where they have been taken.

The letter helps explain waiting in exile; its placement here is thematic, not a date after the fall.

presentations.name: Daniel na corte
presentations.summary:
Jovens de Judá são preparados para servir na corte babilônica e enfrentam questões de fidelidade.

O relato acompanha a experiência do exílio e a preservação de identidade em outro império.

presentations.name: Daniel at court
presentations.summary:
Young men from Judah are trained for service at the Babylonian court and face questions of faithfulness.

The account explores exile and the preservation of identity within another empire.

presentations.name: A fornalha
presentations.summary:
Três companheiros de Daniel se recusam a adorar a imagem real e são lançados na fornalha.

O episódio apresenta o conflito entre exigência imperial e fidelidade religiosa.

presentations.name: The fiery furnace
presentations.summary:
Three of Daniel’s companions refuse to worship the royal image and are thrown into the furnace.

The episode presents the conflict between imperial demands and religious faithfulness.

presentations.name: A visão dos ossos secos
presentations.summary:
Ezequiel vê ossos receberem vida e ouve uma promessa de restauração para Israel.

A visão fala à desesperança do povo e amplia o horizonte para além do exílio.

presentations.name: The vision of dry bones
presentations.summary:
Ezekiel sees bones receive life and hears a promise of restoration for Israel.

The vision addresses the people’s hopelessness and opens a horizon beyond exile.

presentations.name: O decreto de Ciro e o retorno
presentations.summary:
Esdras começa com a autorização de Ciro para reconstruir o templo em Jerusalém.

A narrativa passa do exílio à possibilidade de retorno e reorganização da comunidade.

presentations.name: Cyrus’s decree and the return
presentations.summary:
Ezra opens with Cyrus’s authorization to rebuild the temple in Jerusalem.

The narrative moves from exile to the possibility of return and community rebuilding.

presentations.name: O altar e os alicerces
presentations.summary:
Os retornados restauram o altar e lançam os alicerces do templo entre alegria e choro.

A reconstrução reúne esperança e a memória dolorosa do que foi perdido.

presentations.name: The altar and the foundations
presentations.summary:
The returnees restore the altar and lay the temple’s foundations amid joy and weeping.

Rebuilding brings together hope and painful memory of what was lost.

presentations.name: Ageu incentiva a reconstrução
presentations.summary:
Ageu questiona as prioridades da comunidade e incentiva a retomada das obras.

A mensagem mostra que o retorno não encerrou os desafios da restauração.

presentations.name: Haggai encourages rebuilding
presentations.summary:
Haggai questions the community’s priorities and encourages the resumption of building.

The message shows that return did not end the challenges of restoration.

presentations.name: A conclusão do segundo templo
presentations.summary:
O templo é concluído, dedicado e seguido pela celebração da Páscoa.

O culto comunitário é reorganizado, mas a história da restauração continua.

presentations.name: Completion of the second temple
presentations.summary:
The temple is completed and dedicated, followed by the celebration of Passover.

Communal worship is reorganized, while the story of restoration continues.

presentations.name: Ester intercede por seu povo
presentations.summary:
Ester decide procurar o rei e denuncia a ameaça contra seu povo.

A história amplia o olhar para os judeus que viviam fora da terra de Judá.

presentations.name: Esther intercedes for her people
presentations.summary:
Esther decides to approach the king and exposes the threat against her people.

The story broadens the view to Jewish people living outside the land of Judah.

presentations.name: Esdras e o ensino da Lei
presentations.summary:
Esdras chega a Jerusalém, apresentado como alguém dedicado a estudar, praticar e ensinar a Lei.

A reconstrução da comunidade envolve formação e práticas compartilhadas, além dos edifícios.

presentations.name: Ezra and the teaching of the Law
presentations.summary:
Ezra arrives in Jerusalem, portrayed as devoted to studying, practicing and teaching the Law.

Community rebuilding involves formation and shared practices as well as buildings.

presentations.name: Neemias e os muros
presentations.summary:
Neemias organiza a reconstrução dos muros de Jerusalém em meio à oposição.

O esforço combina liderança, cooperação e proteção da comunidade.

presentations.name: Nehemiah and the walls
presentations.summary:
Nehemiah organizes the rebuilding of Jerusalem’s walls amid opposition.

The effort combines leadership, cooperation and protection of the community.

presentations.name: A leitura pública da Lei
presentations.summary:
O povo se reúne para ouvir a Lei, e o texto é explicado à assembleia.

A compreensão das Escrituras ocupa o centro da renovação comunitária.

presentations.name: The public reading of the Law
presentations.summary:
The people gather to hear the Law, and the text is explained to the assembly.

Understanding Scripture stands at the center of communal renewal.

presentations.name: O anúncio a Maria
presentations.summary:
Maria recebe o anúncio do nascimento de Jesus e responde ao chamado.

Lucas apresenta o nascimento dentro das promessas feitas a Israel.

presentations.name: The announcement to Mary
presentations.summary:
Mary receives the announcement of Jesus’ birth and responds to the call.

Luke presents the birth within the promises made to Israel.

presentations.name: O nascimento de Jesus
presentations.summary:
Jesus nasce em Belém, e pastores recebem a notícia e visitam a criança.

A narrativa une um cenário humilde à linguagem de alegria e salvação.

presentations.name: The birth of Jesus
presentations.summary:
Jesus is born in Bethlehem, and shepherds receive the news and visit the child.

The narrative joins a humble setting with the language of joy and salvation.

presentations.name: O batismo e o início da missão
presentations.summary:
Jesus é batizado por João, passa pelo deserto e começa a anunciar o reino de Deus.

Marcos conecta esses episódios ao início do ministério público.

presentations.name: Baptism and the beginning of the mission
presentations.summary:
Jesus is baptized by John, goes into the wilderness and begins proclaiming God’s kingdom.

Mark connects these episodes with the beginning of public ministry.

presentations.name: Jesus anuncia sua missão
presentations.summary:
Na sinagoga de Nazaré, Jesus lê Isaías e relaciona a passagem à sua atuação.

O episódio oferece uma chave para acompanhar os encontros e conflitos do ministério.

presentations.name: Jesus announces his mission
presentations.summary:
In the Nazareth synagogue, Jesus reads Isaiah and relates the passage to his work.

The episode offers a way to understand the encounters and conflicts of the ministry.

presentations.name: O chamado dos primeiros discípulos
presentations.summary:
Jesus chama pescadores para segui-lo após uma pesca inesperada.

A missão passa a envolver pessoas que aprenderão e participarão de seu caminho.

presentations.name: The calling of the first disciples
presentations.summary:
Jesus calls fishermen to follow him after an unexpected catch.

The mission comes to involve people who will learn and share in his journey.

presentations.name: O Sermão do Monte
presentations.summary:
Jesus ensina sobre o reino, a justiça, a oração e a vida cotidiana.

Mateus reúne ensinamentos que apresentam a prática do discipulado.

presentations.name: The Sermon on the Mount
presentations.summary:
Jesus teaches about the kingdom, righteousness, prayer and everyday life.

Matthew gathers teachings that describe the practice of discipleship.

presentations.name: As parábolas do reino
presentations.summary:
Jesus usa imagens de sementes, solo e crescimento para ensinar.

As parábolas convidam o ouvinte a interpretar e responder à mensagem.

presentations.name: Parables of the kingdom
presentations.summary:
Jesus uses images of seeds, soil and growth to teach.

The parables invite listeners to interpret and respond to the message.

presentations.name: A multiplicação dos pães
presentations.summary:
Jesus acolhe a multidão, ensina e reparte alimento com ela.

O cuidado com a multidão envolve ensino e necessidades concretas.

presentations.name: The feeding of the multitude
presentations.summary:
Jesus welcomes the crowd, teaches and shares food with them.

Care for the crowd involves both teaching and practical needs.

presentations.name: A transfiguração
presentations.summary:
Três discípulos veem Jesus transfigurado, acompanhado de Moisés e Elias.

O episódio relaciona sua identidade à tradição bíblica e ao caminho de sofrimento anunciado.

presentations.name: The transfiguration
presentations.summary:
Three disciples see Jesus transfigured, accompanied by Moses and Elijah.

The episode relates his identity to biblical tradition and the announced path of suffering.

presentations.name: A entrada em Jerusalém
presentations.summary:
Jesus chega a Jerusalém em meio à aclamação e entra no templo.

A chegada abre a etapa final do ministério narrada nos Evangelhos.

presentations.name: The entry into Jerusalem
presentations.summary:
Jesus reaches Jerusalem amid acclamation and enters the temple.

The arrival opens the final stage of the ministry narrated in the Gospels.

presentations.name: A última ceia
presentations.summary:
Jesus partilha a ceia com os discípulos antes de sua prisão.

A refeição liga a memória da Páscoa ao significado que Jesus dá à sua morte.

presentations.name: The last supper
presentations.summary:
Jesus shares supper with the disciples before his arrest.

The meal connects Passover memory with the meaning Jesus gives his death.

presentations.name: A oração e a prisão
presentations.summary:
Jesus ora no Getsêmani e é preso enquanto seus discípulos se dispersam.

A narrativa passa do convívio com os discípulos aos interrogatórios e à condenação.

presentations.name: Prayer and arrest
presentations.summary:
Jesus prays in Gethsemane and is arrested while his disciples scatter.

The narrative moves from fellowship with the disciples to questioning and condemnation.

presentations.name: A crucificação de Jesus
presentations.summary:
Jesus é condenado, crucificado e sepultado.

O relato ocupa o centro da paixão e prepara a leitura do anúncio da ressurreição.

presentations.name: The crucifixion of Jesus
presentations.summary:
Jesus is condemned, crucified and buried.

The account stands at the center of the passion and prepares for the announcement of the resurrection.

presentations.name: A ressurreição e os encontros
presentations.summary:
O túmulo é encontrado vazio, e Lucas narra encontros dos discípulos com Jesus.

Os encontros transformam o luto em testemunho e preparam a continuação em Atos.

presentations.name: The resurrection and the encounters
presentations.summary:
The tomb is found empty, and Luke recounts the disciples’ encounters with Jesus.

The encounters transform grief into witness and prepare the continuation in Acts.

presentations.name: A ascensão e a espera
presentations.summary:
Jesus orienta os discípulos sobre o testemunho e é elevado; eles permanecem reunidos.

Atos apresenta a passagem do ministério de Jesus à missão de seus seguidores.

presentations.name: The ascension and the waiting
presentations.summary:
Jesus instructs the disciples about witness and is taken up; they remain gathered.

Acts presents the transition from Jesus’ ministry to his followers’ mission.

presentations.name: Pentecostes
presentations.summary:
Os discípulos recebem o Espírito, e Pedro anuncia a mensagem à multidão.

O episódio abre a expansão pública do testemunho em Jerusalém.

presentations.name: Pentecost
presentations.summary:
The disciples receive the Spirit, and Peter proclaims the message to the crowd.

The episode opens the public expansion of witness in Jerusalem.

presentations.name: Estêvão e o conflito em Jerusalém
presentations.summary:
Estêvão serve à comunidade, é acusado e morto após seu testemunho.

O conflito antecede a dispersão que levará a mensagem a novos lugares.

presentations.name: Stephen and conflict in Jerusalem
presentations.summary:
Stephen serves the community, is accused and is killed after his testimony.

The conflict precedes the scattering that will carry the message to new places.

presentations.name: Filipe e o viajante etíope
presentations.summary:
Filipe encontra um viajante lendo Isaías e conversa com ele sobre Jesus.

O encontro acompanha a expansão da mensagem para além de Jerusalém.

presentations.name: Philip and the Ethiopian traveler
presentations.summary:
Philip meets a traveler reading Isaiah and speaks with him about Jesus.

The encounter accompanies the message’s expansion beyond Jerusalem.

presentations.name: Saulo no caminho de Damasco
presentations.summary:
Saulo encontra Jesus no caminho, perde a visão e recebe a visita de Ananias.

A mudança de direção de Saulo prepara sua participação na missão.

presentations.name: Saul on the road to Damascus
presentations.summary:
Saul encounters Jesus on the road, loses his sight and receives a visit from Ananias.

Saul’s change of direction prepares his participation in the mission.

presentations.name: Pedro e Cornélio
presentations.summary:
Pedro visita a casa de Cornélio e anuncia Jesus aos que estão reunidos.

O encontro é decisivo no relato de Atos sobre a acolhida dos gentios.

presentations.name: Peter and Cornelius
presentations.summary:
Peter visits Cornelius’s household and proclaims Jesus to those gathered.

The encounter is decisive in Acts’ account of the welcome extended to Gentiles.

presentations.name: A reunião em Jerusalém
presentations.summary:
A comunidade debate o que exigir dos gentios que aderem à fé.

A decisão orienta a convivência entre pessoas de diferentes origens.

presentations.name: The meeting in Jerusalem
presentations.summary:
The community debates what to require of Gentiles coming to faith.

The decision guides life together among people of different backgrounds.

presentations.name: Paulo e Silas em Filipos
presentations.summary:
Em Filipos, a missão inclui o encontro com Lídia e a prisão de Paulo e Silas.

Atos mostra o crescimento da comunidade em meio a hospitalidade e oposição.

presentations.name: Paul and Silas in Philippi
presentations.summary:
In Philippi, the mission includes meeting Lydia and the imprisonment of Paul and Silas.

Acts shows the community growing amid hospitality and opposition.

presentations.name: Paulo em Atenas
presentations.summary:
Paulo dialoga em Atenas e anuncia sua mensagem no Areópago.

O discurso mostra um encontro entre o anúncio cristão e outro ambiente cultural.

presentations.name: Paul in Athens
presentations.summary:
Paul engages in dialogue in Athens and proclaims his message at the Areopagus.

The speech shows an encounter between Christian proclamation and another cultural setting.

presentations.name: Paulo chega a Roma
presentations.summary:
Após a viagem e o naufrágio, Paulo chega a Roma e continua ensinando sob custódia.

Atos termina com a mensagem sendo anunciada, sem encerrar toda a história da igreja.

presentations.name: Paul reaches Rome
presentations.summary:
After the voyage and shipwreck, Paul reaches Rome and continues teaching in custody.

Acts ends with the message being proclaimed, without closing the whole history of the church.

presentations.name: Enoch walks with God
presentations.summary:
In the Genesis genealogy, Enoch is described as walking with God and being taken by him.

The brief passage stands out amid repeated births and deaths. The text does not give a detailed description of what happened, and study should respect that limit.

presentations.name: Enoque anda com Deus
presentations.summary:
Na genealogia de Gênesis, Enoque é descrito como alguém que andou com Deus e foi tomado por ele.

A breve passagem se destaca na repetição de nascimentos e mortes. O texto não fornece uma descrição detalhada do que aconteceu, e o estudo deve respeitar esse limite.

presentations.name: Leaving the ark
presentations.summary:
The waters recede, Noah leaves the ark with his family and offers a sacrifice.

Observe the waiting before departure and Noah’s response. This episode prepares for the covenant in the next chapter; departure and covenant are related stages of the same narrative.

presentations.name: A saída da arca
presentations.summary:
As águas diminuem, Noé sai da arca com sua família e oferece um sacrifício.

Observe a espera antes da saída e a resposta de Noé. Este episódio prepara a aliança do capítulo seguinte; saída e aliança são etapas relacionadas da mesma narrativa.

presentations.name: Abraham and Lot separate
presentations.summary:
A dispute among the herders leads Abram to offer Lot a choice of region and separate from him.

Compare Lot’s grounds for choosing with the promise Abram receives. The account prepares both Lot’s story and the continuing promise of land.

presentations.name: Abraão e Ló se separam
presentations.summary:
A disputa entre os pastores leva Abrão a propor que Ló escolha uma região e se separe dele.

Compare o critério da escolha de Ló com a promessa recebida por Abrão. O relato prepara tanto a trajetória de Ló quanto a continuidade da promessa da terra.

presentations.name: Abraham rescues Lot
presentations.summary:
Abram gathers his men to rescue Lot and later meets Melchizedek.

The conflict places the family within disputes among kings. The blessing and refusal of goods offered by Sodom’s king help explain the conclusion.

presentations.name: Abraão resgata Ló
presentations.summary:
Abrão reúne seus homens para resgatar Ló e depois encontra Melquisedeque.

O conflito coloca a família dentro de disputas entre reis. A bênção e a recusa dos bens oferecidos pelo rei de Sodoma ajudam a entender o desfecho.

presentations.name: Hagar in the wilderness
presentations.summary:
Hagar flees after conflict with Sarai and meets a messenger of God in the wilderness.

Read the promise about Ishmael alongside Hagar’s vulnerability. The account gives attention to a woman on the margins of household power.

presentations.name: Agar no deserto
presentations.summary:
Agar foge após o conflito com Sarai e encontra um mensageiro de Deus no deserto.

Leia a promessa sobre Ismael junto da situação de vulnerabilidade de Agar. O relato dá atenção a uma mulher situada à margem do poder familiar.

presentations.name: Abraham intercedes for Sodom
presentations.summary:
Abraham asks whether the city might be spared because of the righteous living there.

The dialogue raises questions of justice and mercy. It precedes the messengers’ visit to Sodom and Lot’s departure.

presentations.name: Abraão intercede por Sodoma
presentations.summary:
Abraão pergunta sobre a possibilidade de poupar a cidade por causa dos justos que nela vivem.

O diálogo apresenta questões de justiça e misericórdia. A conversa antecede a visita dos mensageiros a Sodoma e a saída de Ló.

presentations.name: Lot leaves Sodom
presentations.summary:
Messengers lead Lot and part of his family out of the city before its destruction.

The account brings together violence, warning and escape. Read it with Abraham’s dialogue in the previous chapter, without reducing the narrative to one isolated detail.

presentations.name: Ló sai de Sodoma
presentations.summary:
Mensageiros retiram Ló e parte de sua família da cidade antes de sua destruição.

O relato reúne violência, advertência e fuga. Leia-o com o diálogo de Abraão no capítulo anterior, sem reduzir toda a narrativa a um detalhe isolado.

presentations.name: Rebekah and Isaac
presentations.summary:
Abraham’s servant travels to seek a wife for Isaac and meets Rebekah.

The journey involves hospitality, prayer and Rebekah’s decision to leave. The formation of this household continues the narrative of the promised descendants.

presentations.name: Rebeca e Isaque
presentations.summary:
Um servo de Abraão viaja em busca de uma esposa para Isaque e encontra Rebeca.

A viagem envolve hospitalidade, oração e a decisão de Rebeca de partir. A formação dessa família dá continuidade à narrativa da descendência prometida.

presentations.name: Esau and the birthright
presentations.summary:
Esau exchanges his birthright for food offered by Jacob.

This episode should be distinguished from the blessing obtained later in Genesis 27. Both accounts help trace the rivalry and its consequences for the family.

presentations.name: Esaú e o direito de primogenitura
presentations.summary:
Esaú troca seu direito de primogenitura por alimento oferecido por Jacó.

O episódio deve ser distinguido da bênção obtida mais tarde em Gênesis 27. Os dois relatos ajudam a acompanhar a rivalidade e suas consequências familiares.

presentations.name: Jacob receives Isaac’s blessing
presentations.summary:
With Rebekah’s help, Jacob presents himself as Esau and receives Isaac’s blessing.

The blessing does not end the conflict: Esau’s threat leads Jacob to leave. Observe how the promise moves through a story marked by troubling human choices.

presentations.name: Jacó recebe a bênção de Isaque
presentations.summary:
Com a ajuda de Rebeca, Jacó se apresenta como Esaú e recebe a bênção de Isaque.

A bênção não encerra o conflito: a ameaça de Esaú leva Jacó a partir. Observe como a promessa atravessa uma história marcada por escolhas humanas problemáticas.

presentations.name: Jacob, Leah and Rachel
presentations.summary:
Jacob works for Laban and marries Leah and Rachel amid deception and conflict.

The narrator draws attention to Leah’s suffering and the beginning of Jacob’s family. Describing these customs does not mean endorsing every action reported.

presentations.name: Jacó, Lia e Raquel
presentations.summary:
Jacó trabalha para Labão e se casa com Lia e Raquel em meio a engano e conflitos.

O narrador chama atenção para o sofrimento de Lia e para o início da família de Jacó. A descrição desses costumes não significa aprovação de todas as condutas relatadas.

presentations.name: Jacob and Esau reunite
presentations.summary:
After years apart, Jacob meets Esau, who runs to embrace him.

Compare Jacob’s fear before the meeting with the welcome he receives. The scene provides a resolution to the rivalry introduced in earlier chapters.

presentations.name: O reencontro de Jacó e Esaú
presentations.summary:
Depois de anos afastados, Jacó encontra Esaú, que corre para abraçá-lo.

Compare o medo expresso por Jacó antes do encontro com o acolhimento que recebe. A cena oferece um desfecho para a rivalidade apresentada nos capítulos anteriores.

presentations.name: Joseph in Potiphar’s house
presentations.summary:
Joseph works in Potiphar’s household, refuses a sexual advance and is imprisoned after a false accusation.

The chapter repeats the affirmation of God’s presence even as Joseph’s situation worsens. Integrity and suffering appear together without an immediate resolution.

presentations.name: José na casa de Potifar
presentations.summary:
José trabalha na casa de Potifar, recusa uma proposta sexual e é preso após uma acusação falsa.

O capítulo repete a afirmação da presença de Deus mesmo quando a situação de José piora. Integridade e sofrimento aparecem juntos, sem uma solução imediata.

presentations.name: Joseph interprets dreams in prison
presentations.summary:
Joseph interprets the dreams of two of Pharaoh’s officials while imprisoned.

The cupbearer’s restoration prepares Joseph’s later encounter with Pharaoh, but Joseph still faces a wait. Observe the distance between promised help and its fulfillment.

presentations.name: José interpreta sonhos na prisão
presentations.summary:
José interpreta os sonhos de dois oficiais de Faraó enquanto está preso.

A restauração do copeiro prepara o encontro posterior com Faraó, mas José ainda passa por uma espera. Observe a distância entre a promessa de ajuda e sua realização.

presentations.name: Joseph before Pharaoh
presentations.summary:
Joseph interprets Pharaoh’s dreams and proposes a response to years of abundance and famine.

Joseph’s change of position prepares the reunion with his brothers. His administration will affect both his family and Egypt’s population.

presentations.name: José diante de Faraó
presentations.summary:
José interpreta os sonhos de Faraó e propõe uma resposta aos anos de abundância e fome.

A mudança de posição de José prepara o reencontro com os irmãos. Sua administração terá consequências para sua família e para a população do Egito.

presentations.name: The plagues in Egypt
presentations.summary:
Moses and Aaron confront Pharaoh, and successive plagues strike Egypt.

Pharaoh’s resistance and repeated negotiations structure these chapters. This selection follows the plagues before the announcement concerning the firstborn and Passover.

presentations.name: As pragas no Egito
presentations.summary:
Moisés e Arão confrontam Faraó, e sucessivas pragas atingem o Egito.

A resistência de Faraó e as negociações repetidas estruturam os capítulos. Esta seleção acompanha as pragas anteriores ao anúncio da morte dos primogênitos e à Páscoa.

presentations.name: The waters of Marah
presentations.summary:
After crossing the sea, the people find bitter water and complain; Moses cries out to God.

The contrast between the song and difficulty finding water shows the journey’s challenges. Deliverance does not immediately remove the need to learn trust.

presentations.name: As águas de Mara
presentations.summary:
Após a travessia do mar, o povo encontra água amarga e reclama; Moisés clama a Deus.

O contraste entre o cântico e a dificuldade de encontrar água mostra os desafios da jornada. A libertação não elimina de imediato a necessidade de aprender a confiar.

presentations.name: The confrontation with Amalek
presentations.summary:
Joshua leads the battle while Moses remains on the hill, supported by Aaron and Hur.

Observe how different people participate in preserving the community. The chapter places the conflict within the difficulties experienced in the wilderness.

presentations.name: O confronto com Amaleque
presentations.summary:
Josué conduz o combate enquanto Moisés permanece no alto do monte, apoiado por Arão e Hur.

Observe a participação de diferentes pessoas na preservação da comunidade. O capítulo situa o conflito dentro das dificuldades vividas no deserto.

presentations.name: Jethro’s advice
presentations.summary:
Jethro observes Moses’ excessive workload and advises sharing responsibility for judging disputes.

The episode relates leadership to limits and community organization. The proposal seeks to make justice accessible without concentrating every decision in one person.

presentations.name: O conselho de Jetro
presentations.summary:
Jetro observa a sobrecarga de Moisés e aconselha a divisão das responsabilidades de julgamento.

O episódio relaciona liderança a limites e organização comunitária. A proposta busca tornar a justiça acessível sem concentrar todas as decisões em uma só pessoa.

presentations.name: The setting up of the tabernacle
presentations.summary:
The tabernacle is set up, and the glory of the Lord fills it.

Exodus ends with God’s presence accompanying the people. The conclusion returns to earlier instructions and prepares the continuation of the journey.

presentations.name: A montagem do tabernáculo
presentations.summary:
O tabernáculo é montado, e a glória do Senhor o enche.

Êxodo termina com a presença de Deus acompanhando o povo. A conclusão retoma instruções anteriores e prepara a continuação da jornada.

presentations.name: The bronze serpent
presentations.summary:
After a crisis along the way, Moses makes a bronze serpent according to the instruction he receives.

Read the sequence of complaint, intercession and response within the wilderness journey. The episode is also recalled in John 3:14–15.

presentations.name: A serpente de bronze
presentations.summary:
Depois de uma crise no caminho, Moisés faz uma serpente de bronze conforme a orientação recebida.

Leia a sequência de murmuração, intercessão e resposta dentro da jornada pelo deserto. O episódio também é retomado em João 3:14–15.

presentations.name: Balaam and the donkey
presentations.summary:
Balaam sets out after being summoned by Balak, but his journey is interrupted by a messenger of God.

The scene questions who can perceive what is happening. It prepares Balaam’s pronouncements in the following chapters.

presentations.name: Balaão e a jumenta
presentations.summary:
Balaão parte após ser chamado por Balaque, mas sua viagem é interrompida por um mensageiro de Deus.

A cena questiona quem consegue perceber o que está acontecendo. Ela prepara os pronunciamentos de Balaão nos capítulos seguintes.

presentations.name: Rahab shelters the spies
presentations.summary:
Rahab hides the spies sent by Joshua and negotiates the preservation of her family.

Her confession and action precede the taking of Jericho. The promise made here helps explain why her family is preserved in chapter 6.

presentations.name: Raabe acolhe os espias
presentations.summary:
Raabe esconde os espias enviados por Josué e negocia a preservação de sua família.

Sua confissão e sua ação antecedem a tomada de Jericó. A promessa feita aqui ajuda a entender por que sua família é preservada no capítulo 6.

presentations.name: Achan and the defeat at Ai
presentations.summary:
After a defeat, an investigation reveals that Achan took goods whose appropriation had been forbidden.

The account connects individual choices and communal consequences within the conquest narrative. Its context of war and judgment calls for careful reading of the whole chapter.

presentations.name: Acã e a derrota em Ai
presentations.summary:
Após uma derrota, a investigação revela que Acã tomou bens cuja apropriação havia sido proibida.

O relato conecta escolhas individuais e consequências comunitárias dentro da narrativa de conquista. Seu contexto de guerra e juízo exige uma leitura atenta do capítulo inteiro.

presentations.name: The distribution of land at Shiloh
presentations.summary:
Joshua gathers the people at Shiloh and directs a survey of the land still to be distributed.

The narrative shifts from campaigns to territorial organization. The following chapters detail the portions assigned to the tribes.

presentations.name: A distribuição da terra em Siló
presentations.summary:
Josué reúne o povo em Siló e orienta o levantamento da terra que ainda seria distribuída.

A narrativa muda o foco das campanhas para a organização territorial. Os capítulos seguintes detalham as porções atribuídas às tribos.

presentations.name: The calling of Gideon
presentations.summary:
Gideon receives a call while Israel suffers Midianite attacks.

His questions and hesitation precede the battle narrated in chapter 7. The account also confronts Baal worship within his own community.

presentations.name: O chamado de Gideão
presentations.summary:
Gideão recebe um chamado enquanto Israel sofre com os ataques midianitas.

Suas perguntas e hesitações precedem a batalha narrada no capítulo 7. O relato também confronta o culto a Baal dentro de sua própria comunidade.

presentations.name: The announcement of Samson’s birth
presentations.summary:
A messenger announces Samson’s birth and gives instructions to his mother.

The announcement places Samson within the history of Philistine oppression. The initial instructions help readers follow the tensions in his later story.

presentations.name: O anúncio do nascimento de Sansão
presentations.summary:
Um mensageiro anuncia o nascimento de Sansão e dá instruções à sua mãe.

O anúncio situa Sansão na história da opressão filisteia. As orientações iniciais ajudam a acompanhar as tensões de sua trajetória posterior.

presentations.name: Samson and Delilah
presentations.summary:
Delilah seeks to discover the source of Samson’s strength, and he is eventually captured by the Philistines.

Read the episode in light of the dedication presented in Judges 13. Its conclusion brings together loss, prayer and conflict without presenting Samson as a flawless model.

presentations.name: Sansão e Dalila
presentations.summary:
Dalila busca descobrir a origem da força de Sansão, que termina capturado pelos filisteus.

Leia o episódio à luz da consagração apresentada em Juízes 13. O desfecho reúne perda, oração e conflito, sem apresentar Sansão como um modelo sem falhas.

presentations.name: Hannah prays and presents Samuel
presentations.summary:
Hannah prays at Shiloh, gives birth to Samuel and later brings him to serve before the Lord.

A family experience of distress opens the narrative that will lead to a change in Israel’s leadership. Hannah’s prayer continues in the following chapter.

presentations.name: Ana ora e apresenta Samuel
presentations.summary:
Ana ora em Siló, dá à luz Samuel e depois o leva para servir diante do Senhor.

Uma experiência familiar de aflição abre a narrativa que levará à mudança da liderança de Israel. A oração de Ana continua no capítulo seguinte.

presentations.name: The ark is captured
presentations.summary:
Israel brings the ark to the battlefield but suffers defeat, and the Philistines capture it.

The account challenges trust in a sacred object as a guarantee of victory. It also presents the end of Eli’s leadership and that of his sons.

presentations.name: A arca é capturada
presentations.summary:
Israel leva a arca ao campo de batalha, mas sofre derrota, e os filisteus a capturam.

O relato confronta a confiança no objeto sagrado como garantia de vitória. Também apresenta o fim da liderança de Eli e de seus filhos.

presentations.name: Samuel confronts Saul
presentations.summary:
Samuel confronts Saul over the way he conducted the campaign against Amalek.

The dialogue places obedience and religious justifications in tension. The episode prepares the search for another king narrated in the next chapter.

presentations.name: Samuel confronta Saul
presentations.summary:
Samuel confronta Saul pela forma como conduziu a campanha contra Amaleque.

O diálogo coloca obediência e justificativas religiosas em tensão. O episódio prepara a busca por outro rei, narrada no capítulo seguinte.

presentations.name: The covenant of David and Jonathan
presentations.summary:
Jonathan helps David assess the danger posed by Saul and confirms his loyalty to his friend.

The friendship develops amid conflict with the royal household. Their commitment will have consequences for Jonathan’s family.

presentations.name: A aliança de Davi e Jônatas
presentations.summary:
Jônatas ajuda Davi a avaliar o perigo representado por Saul e confirma sua lealdade ao amigo.

A amizade se desenvolve em meio ao conflito com a casa real. O compromisso entre os dois terá consequências para a família de Jônatas.

presentations.name: David spares Saul in the cave
presentations.summary:
David has an opportunity to kill Saul but refuses to do so.

Observe the difference between the companions’ suggestion and David’s decision. The encounter does not permanently resolve their conflict.

presentations.name: Davi poupa Saul na caverna
presentations.summary:
Davi tem a oportunidade de matar Saul, mas se recusa a fazê-lo.

Observe a diferença entre a sugestão dos companheiros e a decisão de Davi. O encontro não resolve definitivamente o conflito entre os dois.

presentations.name: Elijah and the widow of Zarephath
presentations.summary:
During the drought, Elijah finds shelter with a widow; the chapter recounts food provision and the restoration of her son’s life.

The story takes place outside Israel and brings together hospitality, scarcity and grief. Read both episodes to follow the development of trust between the characters.

presentations.name: Elias e a viúva de Sarepta
presentations.summary:
Durante a seca, Elias encontra abrigo com uma viúva; o capítulo relata provisão de alimento e a recuperação da vida de seu filho.

A história se passa fora de Israel e reúne hospitalidade, escassez e luto. Leia os dois episódios para acompanhar o desenvolvimento da confiança entre os personagens.

presentations.name: Naboth’s vineyard
presentations.summary:
Naboth refuses to surrender his vineyard; Jezebel arranges a false accusation leading to his death.

Elijah confronts Ahab after the vineyard is seized. The episode relates political power, justice and protection of family inheritance.

presentations.name: A vinha de Nabote
presentations.summary:
Nabote se recusa a ceder sua vinha; Jezabel organiza uma acusação falsa que leva à sua morte.

Elias confronta Acabe depois da apropriação da vinha. O episódio relaciona poder político, justiça e proteção da herança familiar.

presentations.name: Elisha succeeds Elijah
presentations.summary:
Elijah is taken away, and Elisha receives his mantle and continues the prophetic mission.

The crossings of the Jordan before and after their separation structure the account. The continuation of the mission is recognized by the other prophets.

presentations.name: Eliseu sucede Elias
presentations.summary:
Elias é levado, e Eliseu recebe seu manto e continua a missão profética.

A travessia do Jordão antes e depois da separação organiza o relato. A continuidade da missão é reconhecida pelos outros profetas.

presentations.name: Hezekiah faces the Assyrian threat
presentations.summary:
Hezekiah seeks guidance, prays and receives a message from Isaiah amid the threat to Jerusalem.

The chapter continues the crisis described in 2 Kings 18. Distinguish this siege of the city from the earlier fall of the northern kingdom.

presentations.name: Ezequias diante da ameaça assíria
presentations.summary:
Ezequias busca orientação, ora e recebe uma mensagem de Isaías diante da ameaça a Jerusalém.

O capítulo continua a crise descrita em 2 Reis 18. Diferencie este cerco à cidade da queda anterior do reino do norte.

presentations.name: The wedding at Cana
presentations.summary:
During a wedding, Jesus turns water into wine after the supply runs out.

John presents the episode as the beginning of Jesus’ signs. Observe the participation of Mary, the servants and the disciples.

presentations.name: O casamento em Caná
presentations.summary:
Durante um casamento, Jesus transforma água em vinho após a falta da bebida.

João apresenta o episódio como o início dos sinais de Jesus. Observe a participação de Maria, dos serventes e dos discípulos.

presentations.name: Jesus and Nicodemus
presentations.summary:
Nicodemus visits Jesus at night, and the conversation concerns birth from above and the work of the Spirit.

Read the images of birth, wind and the lifted serpent within the dialogue. The chapter connects the conversation with God’s love and the response to light.

presentations.name: Jesus e Nicodemos
presentations.summary:
Nicodemos procura Jesus à noite, e a conversa trata de nascer do alto e da ação do Espírito.

Leia as imagens do nascimento, do vento e da serpente erguida dentro do diálogo. O capítulo conecta a conversa ao amor de Deus e à resposta à luz.

presentations.name: Jesus and the Samaritan woman
presentations.summary:
Jesus speaks with a woman at the well about living water and worship.

The conversation crosses social and religious boundaries and reaches other residents. Observe how the woman’s understanding develops throughout the encounter.

presentations.name: Jesus e a mulher samaritana
presentations.summary:
Jesus conversa com uma mulher junto ao poço sobre água viva e adoração.

A conversa atravessa barreiras sociais e religiosas e alcança outros moradores. Observe como a compreensão da mulher se desenvolve ao longo do encontro.

presentations.name: Jesus calls Lazarus out of the tomb
presentations.summary:
Jesus meets Martha and Mary in mourning and calls Lazarus out of the tomb.

John relates the sign to Jesus’ identity and the growing opposition against him. Read the leaders’ response at the end of the chapter as well.

presentations.name: Jesus chama Lázaro para fora do túmulo
presentations.summary:
Jesus encontra Marta e Maria em luto e chama Lázaro para fora do túmulo.

João relaciona o sinal à identidade de Jesus e ao avanço da oposição contra ele. Leia também a reação dos líderes no final do capítulo.

presentations.name: Jesus meets Zacchaeus
presentations.summary:
Zacchaeus seeks to see Jesus, receives him at home and announces a concrete response concerning his possessions.

The encounter connects welcome, change and restitution. Observe the crowd’s response and Jesus’ explanation of his visit.

presentations.name: Jesus encontra Zaqueu
presentations.summary:
Zaqueu procura ver Jesus, o recebe em casa e anuncia uma resposta concreta sobre seus bens.

O encontro conecta acolhimento, mudança e reparação. Observe a reação da multidão e a explicação que Jesus dá à sua visita.

presentations.name: Priscilla and Aquila guide Apollos
presentations.summary:
Priscilla and Aquila hear Apollos and explain the way of God to him more accurately.

The episode shows learning within the mission and cooperation among different people. Apollos later travels to Achaia with the community’s support.

presentations.name: Priscila e Áquila orientam Apolo
presentations.summary:
Priscila e Áquila ouvem Apolo e lhe explicam o caminho de Deus com mais precisão.

O episódio mostra aprendizado dentro da missão e cooperação entre diferentes pessoas. Apolo depois segue para a Acaia com o apoio da comunidade.

presentations.name: The shipwreck on Paul’s voyage
presentations.summary:
Paul’s voyage as a prisoner is struck by a storm and ends in shipwreck.

The account follows decisions, fear and care for the passengers. Arrival on the island prepares the final stage of the journey narrated in Acts.

presentations.name: O naufrágio na viagem de Paulo
presentations.summary:
A viagem de Paulo como prisioneiro é atingida por uma tempestade e termina em naufrágio.

O relato acompanha decisões, temor e cuidado com os passageiros. A chegada à ilha prepara a última etapa da viagem narrada em Atos.

presentations.name: Jonah flees and faces the storm
presentations.summary:
Jonah sails in the opposite direction to his call, and a storm threatens the ship.

Compare the sailors’ response with Jonah’s. The episode begins a narrative that will question his willingness to participate in the mercy announced by God.

presentations.name: Jonas foge e enfrenta a tempestade
presentations.summary:
Jonas embarca em direção contrária ao chamado recebido, e uma tempestade ameaça o navio.

Compare a reação dos marinheiros com a de Jonas. O episódio inicia uma narrativa que questionará sua disposição de participar da misericórdia anunciada por Deus.

presentations.name: Jonah in Nineveh
presentations.summary:
Jonah proclaims a message to Nineveh, the city responds and the prophet becomes angry at the outcome.

Read both chapters together: Nineveh’s response does not end the book’s central question. The final question invites readers to examine the limits they place on compassion.

presentations.name: Jonas em Nínive
presentations.summary:
Jonas anuncia uma mensagem a Nínive, a cidade reage e o profeta se irrita com o desfecho.

Leia os dois capítulos juntos: a resposta de Nínive não encerra a questão central do livro. A pergunta final convida o leitor a examinar os limites que coloca à compaixão.

presentations.name: Daniel in the lions’ den
presentations.summary:
Daniel maintains his practice of prayer despite a royal decree and is thrown into the lions’ den.

The account presents faithfulness under pressure and conflict between imperial law and religious conscience. Its placement here is contextual, without fixing an absolute chronology between empires.

presentations.name: Daniel na cova dos leões
presentations.summary:
Daniel mantém sua prática de oração apesar de um decreto real e é lançado na cova dos leões.

O relato apresenta fidelidade sob pressão e o conflito entre a lei imperial e a consciência religiosa. Seu lugar aqui é contextual, sem fixar uma cronologia absoluta entre impérios.

presentations.name: Jesus and Bartimaeus
presentations.summary:
Bartimaeus calls out to Jesus, receives sight and follows him on the way.

Observe Bartimaeus’s persistence and the crowd’s change of attitude. The episode appears near Jesus’ arrival in Jerusalem.

presentations.name: Jesus e Bartimeu
presentations.summary:
Bartimeu chama por Jesus, recebe a visão e o segue pelo caminho.

Observe a insistência de Bartimeu e a mudança de atitude da multidão. O episódio aparece perto da chegada de Jesus a Jerusalém.

presentations.name: Jesus calms the storm
presentations.summary:
During a crossing, the disciples wake Jesus amid a storm, and he commands it to cease.

The account ends with a question about Jesus’ identity. Compare the disciples’ fear during the storm with their reaction after the calm.

presentations.name: Jesus acalma a tempestade
presentations.summary:
Durante uma travessia, os discípulos acordam Jesus em meio à tempestade, e ele ordena que ela cesse.

O relato termina com uma pergunta sobre a identidade de Jesus. Compare o temor dos discípulos diante da tempestade com sua reação depois da calmaria.

presentations.name: Jairus’s daughter and the sick woman
presentations.summary:
On the way to Jairus’s house, Jesus attends to a sick woman; afterward, he finds Jairus’s daughter already dead.

Mark intertwines the two encounters to develop questions of fear and trust. Read the interruption and resumption of the journey as parts of the same narrative composition.
aliases: Woman with a flow of blood

presentations.name: A filha de Jairo e a mulher enferma
presentations.summary:
A caminho da casa de Jairo, Jesus atende uma mulher enferma; depois, encontra a filha de Jairo já morta.

Marcos entrelaça os dois encontros para desenvolver as questões de medo e confiança. Leia a interrupção e a retomada da viagem como partes da mesma composição narrativa.

presentations.name: The paralytic brought to Jesus
presentations.summary:
Four men bring a paralytic to Jesus through the roof; Jesus announces forgiveness and heals him.

The scribes’ response shifts the question from healing to authority to forgive. Observe the relationship between the friends’ action, Jesus’ words and the resulting conflict.

presentations.name: O paralítico levado até Jesus
presentations.summary:
Quatro homens levam um paralítico até Jesus pelo telhado; Jesus anuncia perdão e o cura.

A reação dos escribas desloca a questão da cura para a autoridade de perdoar. Observe a relação entre a ação dos amigos, a fala de Jesus e o conflito que surge.

sources.citation: Verbum — estudos de acontecimentos bíblicos / biblical event studies. Original bilingual editorial notes with chapter references.

entities.name: Creation
entities.summary:
God creates and orders the world, giving humanity a vocation within it.

Genesis introduces creation, human dignity and responsibility as foundations of the narrative.

entities.name: The garden and humanity’s calling
entities.summary:
The human being is placed in the garden to cultivate and care for it.

Work, boundaries and companionship appear before the rupture narrated in the next chapter.

entities.name: Disobedience and departure from Eden
entities.summary:
Disobedience breaks trust and leads to departure from the garden.

The narrative connects shame, conflict and mortality with the need for restoration.

entities.name: Cain and Abel
entities.summary:
Cain kills his brother, and God confronts him about the blood shed.

Human conflict expands from disobedience to violence between brothers.

entities.name: Noah and the ark
entities.summary:
In a world marked by violence, Noah receives instructions to build the ark.

The account places judgment alongside the preservation of life.

entities.name: The flood
entities.summary:
Noah, his family and the animals enter the ark before the waters arrive.

This episode continues the ark narrative and prepares for a new beginning after the flood.

entities.name: The covenant with Noah
entities.summary:
God establishes a covenant with Noah, his descendants and living creatures.

The rainbow accompanies a promise of preservation and renewed instructions for life.

entities.name: The tower of Babel
entities.summary:
The building of a city and tower ends with the scattering of peoples.

From the scattering of nations, Genesis turns to a family connected with the promise of blessing.

entities.name: The calling of Abraham
entities.summary:
Abram leaves his homeland in response to a call accompanied by promises.

The promise of land, descendants and blessing guides the patriarchal narrative.

entities.name: The covenant with Abraham
entities.summary:
Abram voices doubts about descendants and receives a promise confirmed by covenant.

The episode deepens the relationship between trust, promise and waiting.

entities.name: The birth of Isaac
entities.summary:
Sarah gives birth to Isaac, the son promised to Abraham.

The birth marks a stage in the promise, while family conflicts continue.

entities.name: Abraham is tested
entities.summary:
Abraham takes Isaac to the mountain; a messenger stops the sacrifice and a ram is offered.

The account concerns testing, trust and provision and should be read through to its conclusion.

entities.name: Jacob’s dream at Bethel
entities.summary:
During his journey, Jacob dreams and receives the promise of God’s presence.

The promises made to Abraham reappear in the next generation’s story.

entities.name: Jacob receives the name Israel
entities.summary:
Before meeting Esau, Jacob wrestles through the night and receives a new name.

The name Israel links Jacob’s experience to the identity of the people descended from him.

entities.name: Joseph is sold
entities.summary:
Joseph’s brothers sell him, and he is taken to Egypt.

Family conflict moves the narrative to the setting where Israel will later live.

entities.name: Joseph reveals himself to his brothers
entities.summary:
Joseph reveals his identity and invites the family to live in Egypt during the famine.

The family reunion explains the transition from the patriarchs to the opening of Exodus.

entities.name: The birth of Moses
entities.summary:
Moses is preserved as a baby and grows up in Pharaoh’s daughter’s household.

His story begins between the oppression of his people and the Egyptian court.

entities.name: The call at the burning bush
entities.summary:
God calls Moses to lead the Israelites out of Egypt.

The call responds to the suffering described at the beginning of Exodus.

entities.name: The first Passover
entities.summary:
Households receive instructions for Passover on the night of departure from Egypt.

Deliverance becomes the focus of a celebration handed down through generations.

entities.name: Leaving Egypt and crossing the sea
entities.summary:
The Israelites cross the sea while the Egyptian army pursues them.

The crossing holds a central place in the biblical memory of deliverance.

entities.name: Manna in the wilderness
entities.summary:
The people receive food in the wilderness and instructions for gathering it.

After leaving Egypt, the narrative turns to dependence and daily life in freedom.

entities.name: The covenant at Sinai
entities.summary:
Israel reaches Sinai and receives commandments guiding its life as a people.

Deliverance is followed by a covenant involving worship, community and responsibility.

entities.name: The golden calf
entities.summary:
During Moses’ absence, the people make a golden calf; Moses intercedes.

The crisis exposes the fragility of faithfulness to the newly established covenant.

entities.name: The spies and the crisis of trust
entities.summary:
The spies’ report divides the people and leads to their refusal to enter the land.

The episode explains the prolonged wilderness journey within the narrative.

entities.name: The death of Moses
entities.summary:
Moses sees the land before dying, and Joshua takes up leadership.

The conclusion of the Pentateuch prepares a change of generation and leadership.

entities.name: Crossing the Jordan
entities.summary:
Under Joshua’s leadership, the people cross the Jordan.

The crossing marks the transition from the wilderness journey to entering the land.

entities.name: Jericho
entities.summary:
Joshua recounts the taking of Jericho and the preservation of Rahab and her family.

It is an episode in the conquest narrative involving judgment, war and refuge.

entities.name: Renewing the covenant
entities.summary:
Joshua gathers the people at Shechem to recall their history and renew their commitment to God.

Memory of the journey grounds the decision about how to live in the land.

entities.name: Deborah and Barak
entities.summary:
Deborah guides Barak in the struggle against Sisera’s forces.

The account brings together prophetic leadership and the decisive participation of several people.

entities.name: Gideon and the small army
entities.summary:
Gideon’s army is reduced before confronting the Midianites.

The reduction shifts attention from military strength to dependence on God.

entities.name: Ruth and Naomi
entities.summary:
Ruth accompanies Naomi to Bethlehem, and the story ends with a family linked to David’s line.

Set in the time of the judges, the narrative highlights loyalty and care amid vulnerability.

entities.name: The calling of Samuel
entities.summary:
Samuel hears God’s call while serving with Eli.

His work will bridge the period of the judges and the formation of the monarchy.

entities.name: Israel asks for a king
entities.summary:
The people ask for a king, and Samuel describes the costs of this form of rule.

The episode introduces tensions that will accompany the monarchy.

entities.name: Saul is anointed
entities.summary:
Samuel anoints Saul, who is later presented to the people as king.

Leadership now includes a royal institution without ending the prophets’ role.

entities.name: The anointing of David
entities.summary:
Samuel goes to Jesse’s house and anoints David.

The choice occurs before David takes the throne, beginning a long transition.

entities.name: David and Goliath
entities.summary:
David faces Goliath while the armies of Israel and the Philistines are gathered.

The episode brings David into public view and contrasts appearance, strength and trust.

entities.name: David reigns and takes Jerusalem
entities.summary:
David is recognized as king over all Israel and takes Jerusalem.

The city takes a central place in the monarchy’s story.

entities.name: The promise to David’s house
entities.summary:
Nathan delivers a promise to David concerning his descendants and kingdom.

The promise becomes an important reference for royal hope in Scripture.

entities.name: Nathan confronts David
entities.summary:
After David’s actions against Bathsheba and Uriah, Nathan confronts the king.

The narrative shows that royal power is also subject to moral judgment.

entities.name: Solomon asks for wisdom
entities.summary:
Early in his reign, Solomon asks for discernment to govern.

Wisdom is presented in relation to the responsibility to administer justice.

entities.name: The dedication of the temple
entities.summary:
Solomon gathers the people for the temple’s dedication and offers a prayer.

The temple becomes a reference point for worship, prayer, repentance and covenant memory.

entities.name: The division of the kingdom
entities.summary:
After Solomon, conflict with Rehoboam results in the separation of the kingdoms.

From here, Kings follows the parallel histories of Israel and Judah.

entities.name: Elijah on Mount Carmel
entities.summary:
Elijah confronts the prophets of Baal before the people.

The confrontation places religious allegiance at the center of the northern kingdom’s crisis.

entities.name: Elijah at Horeb
entities.summary:
Elijah flees, receives care and finds renewed direction for his mission.

The narrative moves from public confrontation to vulnerability and the continuation of prophetic calling.

entities.name: Elisha and Naaman
entities.summary:
Naaman seeks healing and receives instructions from Elisha that he initially rejects.

The encounter crosses political boundaries and challenges expectations of prestige and power.

entities.name: The calling of Isaiah
entities.summary:
Isaiah recounts a vision, his cleansing and his commission to proclaim a message.

The call introduces the tension between holiness, the people’s resistance and prophetic mission.

entities.name: The fall of Samaria
entities.summary:
The northern kingdom falls under Assyrian rule, and part of its population is deported.

Kings interprets the fall in light of Israel’s religious and political history.

entities.name: Josiah and the book of the Law
entities.summary:
A book is found in the temple, and Josiah leads a renewal of the covenant.

Public reading and reform show the role of written memory in the people’s life.

entities.name: Jeremiah and the temple sermon
entities.summary:
Jeremiah challenges confidence in the temple when daily conduct contradicts the covenant.

The warning prepares readers to understand Jerusalem’s crisis beyond trust in its institutions.

entities.name: The fall of Jerusalem and exile
entities.summary:
